name: page-shell
title: Page Shell
description: The one page wrapper every route uses: vertical rhythm, the body-size baseline, a content width tier (full/wide/narrow/form) and a header row carrying the breadcrumb, tabs and page actions. Everything app-specific is a slot, so the file is identical in every repo. Implements platform/standards/ui-layout.md. No next/* import — works in any React app.
